players.product: leading-edge wafer fab (N3/N2 GAA logic dies)

contracts.signal: Broadcom's 10-K states that the majority of its front-end wafer manufacturing is outsourced to external foundries including TSMC, and that during fiscal year 2025 approximately 95% of the wafers manufactured by its contract manufacturers were produced by TSMC. The figure covers all wafers made for Broadcom by its contract manufacturers; the filing does not break it out by product line. Broadcom believes its wafer requirements represent a meaningful portion of TSMC's total production capacity and notes TSMC has raised its prices to manufacture Broadcom's wafers; Broadcom generally has no long-term capacity commitments with its contract manufacturers and substantially all manufacturing services are on a purchase order basis with no minimum quantities.
contracts.units: approximately 95% of wafers manufactured by Broadcom's contract manufacturers (all products)
